# Category Manager, Fresh Produce

**Kløvermark Supermarkeder** · Copenhagen (hybrid, mostly at our head office) · 1 position

Kløvermark runs 40 neighbourhood supermarkets on Zealand. We are looking for a category
manager for fruit and vegetables, our most important category.

## What you will do

- Own the range, prices and promotions for fresh produce.
- Negotiate with growers and importers in Denmark and abroad.
- Follow sales and waste every week and act on them.
- Work with store managers on displays and ordering.

## What we are looking for

- At least 5 years in grocery retail buying or category management.
- Experience negotiating with suppliers.
- You plan and evaluate promotions.
- Strong Excel.
- Fluent Danish, spoken and written.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Experience with demand forecasting or ordering systems.
- Some SQL.
- You enjoy working with store managers and colleagues across the business.

We offer a company car, staff discount and a seat at the table where the range is decided.
